name: Z-Fighting / Polygon Flickering
symptoms: Polygons flicker or shimmer when viewed from certain angles
Overlapping surfaces alternate visibility rapidly
Flickering worsens as camera moves further away
Co-planar geometry exhibits unstable rendering
possibleCauses: Two or more primitives share the same geometric plane with no depth offset
Depth buffer precision insufficient for the scene scale (logarithmic depth disabled)
Near/far clipping plane ratio too extreme (e.g. near=0.1, far=1e12)
logarithmicDepthBuffer not enabled on Scene
Depth plane (DepthPlane) misconfigured for the globe ellipsoid
investigationSteps: Check if scene.logarithmicDepthBuffer is enabled
Inspect the near/far clipping plane ratio on Camera.frustum
Verify whether the affected primitives are co-planar
Check if DepthPlane is configured correctly for the scene ellipsoid
Enable wireframe mode to visualize overlapping geometry
Check RenderState.depthMask and depthTest settings on affected primitives
fixSuggestions: Enable scene.logarithmicDepthBuffer = true for large-scale scenes
Add a small vertical offset (height) to one of the co-planar primitives
Adjust Camera.frustum near plane to a larger value to improve depth precision
Use Primitive.allowPicking = false on background geometry to reduce picking conflicts
Ensure GroundPrimitive uses classificationType correctly to avoid terrain overlap

name: Depth Precision Loss
symptoms: Distant objects clip or disappear unexpectedly
Nearby objects render behind farther objects
Depth sorting artifacts at extreme camera distances
Scene looks correct at close range but breaks when zooming out
possibleCauses: Camera frustum near plane set too small (e.g. 0.01) combined with very large far plane
logarithmicDepthBuffer disabled on Scene
Custom frustum overrides the default PerspectiveFrustum settings
Depth buffer bit depth insufficient (16-bit vs 24-bit or 32-bit)
investigationSteps: Log camera.frustum.near and camera.frustum.far values
Calculate the near/far ratio — values exceeding 1:1e6 indicate precision risk
Check scene.logarithmicDepthBuffer status
Inspect WebGL context parameters for depth buffer bit depth
Verify no custom frustum override is active
fixSuggestions: Enable scene.logarithmicDepthBuffer = true
Increase camera.frustum.near to at least 1.0 for globe-scale scenes
Reduce camera.frustum.far to the minimum required distance
Use scene.completeMinimumPixelWidth to manage distant object rendering
Request a 32-bit depth buffer via context creation attributes if possible

name: Terrain and GroundPrimitive Conflict
symptoms: GroundPrimitive flickers over terrain surface
ClassificationPrimitive does not align with terrain elevation
Polygons appear to float above or sink below terrain
Terrain tiles show visual artifacts near classification boundaries
possibleCauses: GroundPrimitive depthFailAppearance not configured for terrain-relative rendering
ClassificationPrimitive classificationType mismatch with terrain provider
Terrain provider not fully loaded when GroundPrimitive is added
Terrain depth test disabled (scene.globe.depthTestAgainstTerrain = false)
investigationSteps: Check scene.globe.depthTestAgainstTerrain setting
Verify TerrainProvider readiness state before adding GroundPrimitive
Inspect GroundPrimitive appearance and depthFailAppearance
Check ClassificationPrimitive.classificationType value
Enable wireframe on globe to visualize terrain mesh alignment
fixSuggestions: Set scene.globe.depthTestAgainstTerrain = true for accurate depth testing
Wait for TerrainProvider.readyPromise before adding GroundPrimitive
Use depthFailAppearance on GroundPrimitive to visualize depth failures
Ensure ClassificationPrimitive uses ClassificationType.BOTH for terrain + 3D Tiles
Add a small height offset to the GroundPrimitive geometry instances

name: Primitive Performance Degradation
symptoms: Frame rate drops significantly after adding primitives
Scene becomes unresponsive during primitive updates
GPU memory usage spikes when many primitives are active
Draw call count exceeds expected values
possibleCauses: Too many individual Primitive instances instead of batched PrimitiveCollection
Geometry not merged — each Primitive triggers a separate draw call
Frequent appearance updates causing shader recompilation
asynchronous geometry computation blocking the render loop
Excessive vertex count per primitive without LOD or simplification
investigationSteps: Count the number of active Primitive instances in scene.primitives
Check if primitives use merged geometry (GeometryInstances array)
Monitor draw call count via scene.debugShowFramesPerSecond
Profile GPU time per frame using browser devtools
Check if appearance.material is shared across primitives
fixSuggestions: Batch multiple geometry instances into a single Primitive
Use PrimitiveCollection for logical grouping but minimize total count
Share Material instances across primitives with the same appearance
Enable scene.requestRenderMode = true to avoid unnecessary renders
Use asynchronous=false for geometry that does not need background computation

name: Label Disappears or Not Visible
symptoms: Labels disappear at certain camera angles or distances
Labels render behind terrain or 3D Tiles
Labels are clipped at the viewport edge
Labels flicker when camera moves slightly
possibleCauses: Label disableDepthTestDistance not set — labels occluded by terrain
Label pixelOffset places the label outside the visible viewport
Label translucencyByDistance hides label beyond a threshold
Label scaleByDistance reduces scale to zero at far distances
Label eyeOffset pushes label behind geometry
investigationSteps: Check label.disableDepthTestDistance — set to Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY for always-visible
Inspect label.translucencyByDistance near/far values
Inspect label.scaleByDistance near/far values
Verify label.pixelOffset and label.eyeOffset
Check if the label position is inside a 3D Tile or terrain surface
fixSuggestions: Set label.disableDepthTestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
Adjust label.translucencyByDistance to keep labels opaque at working distances
Use label.eyeOffset to push labels slightly toward the camera
Set label.verticalOrigin = VerticalOrigin.BOTTOM to anchor labels above geometry
Verify label.show = true and label.text is non-empty

name: 3D Tiles Jitter / Oscillation
symptoms: 3D Tiles tileset oscillates or jitters when camera is near
Tiles shift position slightly during camera movement
Tile boundaries show visible seams that change with view angle
Tileset appears to float or sink relative to terrain
possibleCauses: Tileset modelMatrix includes floating-point precision loss at large coordinates
Tileset root transform conflicts with globe ellipsoid position
Camera near plane too close causing precision issues on tile transforms
Tile bounding volumes (BoundingSphere / OBB) inaccurate causing culling artifacts
Multiple tilesets overlap with conflicting coordinate systems
investigationSteps: Log tileset.modelMatrix translation values — check for large coordinate magnitudes
Inspect tileset.root.boundingVolume for accuracy
Check camera position relative to tileset center
Enable scene.debugShowBoundingVolume to visualize tile bounds
Verify tileset is not positioned at origin (0,0,0) far from the globe surface
fixSuggestions: Use Cesium3DTileset.fromUrl() with skipLevelOfDetail optimization flags
Apply tileset.modelMatrix relative to a local ENU frame near the tileset center
Increase camera.frustum.near to improve depth precision near tiles
Enable tileset.skipLevelOfDetail = true for smoother transitions
Ensure tileset.maximumMemoryUsage is not too low causing aggressive unloading

name: 3D Tiles Loading Failure
symptoms: Tileset fails to load or shows blank area
Tiles load partially but some regions remain empty
Network requests for tile content fail with 404 or CORS errors
Tileset.allTilesLoaded() never resolves
possibleCauses: tileset.json URL is incorrect or unreachable
CORS headers missing on tile server
RequestScheduler throttling blocks tile requests
Tile content references external resources that fail to load
Network timeout on large b3dm/i3dm/pnts payloads
investigationSteps: Check browser network tab for failed tile requests (404, CORS, timeout)
Verify tileset.json URL is accessible directly
Inspect RequestScheduler statistics for throttled requests
Check Cesium3DTileset.tileLoadProgressEvent for progress updates
Verify server CORS headers include Access-Control-Allow-Origin
fixSuggestions: Use Resource with custom headers for authenticated tile servers
Increase RequestScheduler.maximumRequestsPerServer if throttled
Verify tileset.json path is correct and uses HTTPS if required
Configure tile server CORS headers or use a proxy
Use tileset.initialTilesLoaded promise to confirm first batch completion

name: Picking Failure
symptoms: scene.pick() returns undefined even when clicking on visible objects
Picking selects the wrong object behind the target
Drill-pick returns incomplete results
Picking works intermittently depending on camera angle
possibleCauses: Primitive.allowPicking = false on the target primitive
Picking stage skipped due to custom render pipeline modification
Object rendered in translucent pass with pickTranslucentDepth disabled
Picking framebuffer not updated before pick call
Picking color collision due to excessive object count
investigationSteps: Check primitive.allowPicking on the target object
Verify scene.pickTranslucentDepth if picking translucent objects
Ensure scene.pick() is called after the render frame completes
Check if the pick position is within the canvas bounds
Enable scene.debugShowPicking to visualize the pick framebuffer
fixSuggestions: Set primitive.allowPicking = true on the target object
Enable scene.pickTranslucentDepth = true for translucent geometry
Call scene.pick() inside a postRender event handler
Use scene.drillPick() for overlapping objects
Reduce total pickable object count if exceeding pick color space

name: Shader Compile Error
symptoms: WebGL shader compilation fails with error log in console
Primitives render as black or invisible after shader error
Shader link error reported in browser console
Custom material or appearance fails to apply
possibleCauses: GLSL syntax error in custom shader source
Uniform name mismatch between JavaScript and GLSL
Unsupported GLSL extension or precision qualifier
Shader source contains preprocessor directives that fail on target platform
AutomaticUniforms referenced incorrectly in custom material
investigationSteps: Copy the shader error log from browser console
Identify the failing shader line number from the error message
Check GLSL version compatibility (WebGL 1.0 vs 2.0)
Verify uniform names match between appearance and GLSL source
Test the shader in isolation using a minimal primitive
fixSuggestions: Fix the GLSL syntax error at the reported line number
Use ShaderSource.defines to conditionally enable features per platform
Verify AutomaticUniforms names match Cesium's built-in uniform list
Add precision highp float; at the top of fragment shaders
Use ShaderProgram.fromCache to avoid redundant compilation

name: LOD Popping / Level of Detail Artifacts
symptoms: Tiles or geometry suddenly pop in/out as camera moves
Visible seams appear between different LOD levels
Geometry appears to jump in scale during transitions
Distant objects suddenly snap to higher detail
possibleCauses: skipLevelOfDetail disabled causing abrupt tile transitions
maximumScreenSpaceError too aggressive causing premature LOD switches
Tile geometric complexity varies too much between adjacent levels
Fog or distance display conditions not smoothing LOD transitions
Cesium3DTileset preloadWhenHidden causing deferred loading spikes
investigationSteps: Check tileset.skipLevelOfDetail and related skip flags
Inspect tileset.maximumScreenSpaceError value
Enable scene.debugShowBoundingVolume to visualize tile selection
Monitor tileset.tileLoadProgressEvent during camera movement
Check if fog (scene.fog) is enabled to mask distant LOD transitions
fixSuggestions: Enable tileset.skipLevelOfDetail = true for smoother transitions
Increase tileset.maximumScreenSpaceError to reduce premature detail loading
Enable scene.fog to naturally mask distant LOD transitions
Set tileset.preloadWhenHidden = false to avoid deferred loading spikes
Use tileset.foveatedScreenSpaceError to prioritize center-of-view tiles
